targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: one card per selected machine using latest known evidence. */
WITH equipment AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT equipment_id
  FROM public.machine_event
  WHERE equipment_id IS NOT NULL
), latest_status AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (equipment_id)
         equipment_id, event_type, event_code, event_message, event_time, id
  FROM public.machine_event
  WHERE message_type = 'status'
  ORDER BY equipment_id, event_time DESC, id DESC
), latest_program AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (equipment_id) equipment_id, event_message, event_time
  FROM public.machine_event
  WHERE event_type = 'PROGRAM_LOAD'
  ORDER BY equipment_id, event_time DESC, id DESC
), latest_error AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (equipment_id) equipment_id, event_code, event_message, event_time
  FROM public.machine_event
  WHERE message_type = 'alarm' AND level = 'E'
  ORDER BY equipment_id, event_time DESC, id DESC
)
SELECT e.equipment_id AS "Machine",
       CASE s.event_type WHEN 'RUN' THEN 'RUN' WHEN 'STOP' THEN 'STOP' ELSE 'Undefine' END AS "StateLabel",
       CASE s.event_type WHEN 'RUN' THEN 'run' WHEN 'STOP' THEN 'stop' ELSE 'undefined' END AS "StateClass",
       COALESCE(s.event_code, 'N/A') AS "Code",
       COALESCE(s.event_message, 'No status evidence') AS "Message",
       COALESCE(to_char(s.event_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'N/A') AS "ObservedAt",
       CASE
         WHEN s.event_time IS NULL THEN 'N/A'
         WHEN NOW() - s.event_time < INTERVAL '1 hour' THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - s.event_time)) / 60)::TEXT || ' min'
         WHEN NOW() - s.event_time < INTERVAL '1 day' THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - s.event_time)) / 3600)::TEXT || ' hr'
         ELSE ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - s.event_time)) / 86400)::TEXT || ' day'
       END AS "Age",
       COALESCE(CASE WHEN s.event_message ~* 'Run Hits\s*:'
         THEN (regexp_match(s.event_message, 'Run Hits\s*:\s*([0-9]+)', 'i'))[1]
       END, 'N/A') AS "RunHits",
       COALESCE(p.event_message, 'N/A') AS "Program",
       COALESCE(CASE WHEN er.event_code ~ '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN 'E' || er.event_code ELSE er.event_code END, 'N/A') AS "LastError",
       COALESCE(to_char(er.event_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'N/A') AS "ErrorAt"
FROM equipment e
LEFT JOIN latest_status s USING (equipment_id)
LEFT JOIN latest_program p USING (equipment_id)
LEFT JOIN latest_error er USING (equipment_id)
WHERE (${status_filter:sqlstring} = 'All' OR s.event_type = ${status_filter:sqlstring})
  AND (${program_search:sqlstring} = '' OR COALESCE(p.event_message, '') ILIKE '%' || ${program_search:sqlstring} || '%')
ORDER BY e.equipment_id
